description.value: Foamers' Folly Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and full-service tasting room in Pitt Meadows, BC, pouring 20 taps of house-made beer alongside rotating wine and cider. The tasting room is known for adventurous, boundary-pushing recipes — wild sours, fruit lagers, and hard seltzers sit alongside approachable core styles. A beautiful patio, food menu, and regular events make it a natural gathering point for cyclists passing through the Pitt Meadows flats.
